einzeiler: John Randolph discovers a horrifying campsite in a remote Colorado forest.
kurzfassung: While hiking in a remote Colorado forest, John Randolph follows a foul smell to a clearing. There, he stumbles upon a bizarre and long-term campsite. Upon closer inspection, he makes a horrifying discovery that forces him to flee.
stichpunkte: John Randolph hikes through a remote forest in Colorado
He notices a terrible smell and follows it to a clearing
The clearing contains what appears to be an old, long-term campsite
John discovers something horrifying in the middle of the camp
He realizes the sight is real and flees the scene screaming for help
beschreibung:
One summer day, a man named John Randolph was hiking through a remote forest in Colorado when he began to smell something terrible. Intrigued, he followed the smell until it brought him to this clearing, and in the clearing John saw what looked like an old campsite. Now, John is out in the middle of nowhere, so the idea that somebody was camping out out here, in what looked like a long term settlement, was pretty bizarre to John. John walked into the clearing to see what was going on, and when he turned the corner, he saw something in the middle of the campsite he just couldn’t even process... it was so horrible, it just looked fake. But eventually, he realized what he was looking at was real, at which point John turned around and began sprinting out of there screaming for help.
